source_policy.note: Everything builds inside the pinned mlp1-toolchain container from lock-verified source archives. System ABI boundary: OpenSSL (libssl.so.3/libcrypto.so.3), SQLite (libsqlite3.so.0), libffi (libffi.so.8), expat (libexpat.so.1), zlib (libz.so.1), glibc 2.38 come from the MLP1 stock rootfs (verified present 2026-08-14); liblzma is bundled because stock MLP1 has none. No OpenSSL rpath; no PortMaster prefix or artifacts.
source_policy.docker_images: allowed only as pinned build environments
preferred_order: build from source in the MLP1 toolchain container
use pinned upstream release archives with license, size, and SHA-256

source_inputs.license: liblzma: 0BSD; source package includes mixed free licenses for uninstalled tools/docs
source_inputs.note: Identical archive to the proven PortMaster-mlp1 ui-runtime lock (hash matches); built here under the RAOfflineProxy prefix, not copied from that artifact.
Version taken from the bundle header 'Certificate data from Mozilla as of: Thu Aug 13 03:12:01 2026 GMT'. Shipped at <pak>/runtime/ca-certificates.crt and selected explicitly via SSL_CERT_FILE.

source_inputs.license: MIT; bundled md5.c/md5.h are Aladdin Enterprises zlib-style
source_inputs.purpose: rc_hash, built into libraproxy_rchash.so so the pak can compute a RetroAchievements ROM hash without launching the game
source_inputs.version_policy: PIN TO THE VERSION THE DEVICE'S RETROARCH VENDORS (currently 12.1.0), not upstream latest. A pre-computed hash that disagrees with the one rcheevos produces inside RetroArch writes cache under a key nothing ever looks up. Move this pin when the RetroArch build moves, and re-run the hash-agreement device check.
source_inputs.notes: Upstream tarball, not RetroArch's deps/rcheevos copy: that one is patched to include libretro-common's <lrc_hash.h> and does not build standalone. hash_encrypted.c/aes.c (3DS) are excluded; MLP1 has no 3DS.

source_inputs.license: BSD-3-Clause; vendors lzma-25.01 (public domain), miniz-3.1.1 (MIT), zstd-1.5.7 (BSD-3/GPL-2 dual)
source_inputs.purpose: CHD reading, so rc_hash can hash .chd disc images. rcheevos has no built-in CHD support: it exposes a pluggable rc_hash_cdreader_t and expects the host to supply one.
source_inputs.notes: Vendored deps are built in, so this adds no new runtime shared-library dependency. Covers the four CD systems (DC, PCECD, PS, SEGACD) that raproxy_hash_file cannot otherwise hash.
